parameters.query:
SELECT id, clinic_name, website, city, area, phone, whatsapp, public_email,
       category, priority_tier, source, domain
FROM acq.claim_leads(ARRAY['NEW']::acq.lead_status[], 50, $1)

nodes.name: Claim New Leads
nodes.notes: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED inside claim_leads means overlapping runs take disjoint work instead of colliding.
